inputs.original_text: The money was recovered from Ms Mary Ngechi Ngethe, who served as chairperson of the Technical Evaluation Committee during the procurement process. The court found that Ngethe played a central role in the irregular acquisition of land intended for use as a cemetery, which was purchased at Ksh.283 million despite being unsuitable.
inputs.modified_text: This just shows the rot that sets in when those in power abandon personal responsibility and the authority they were entrusted with. Ms Mary Ngechi Ngethe, who chaired the Technical Evaluation Committee, was right at the center of this improper land purchase for a cemetery at Ksh.283 million, even though the site was unsuitable. The court rightly ordered the full amount recovered from her. Such misconduct by officials erodes the social order, squanders resources meant to serve families and communities, and weakens the cultural continuity that keeps society stable. We need leaders who uphold duty, accountability, and respect for tradition instead of schemes that betray the public trust.
